name: Rosebury Hangman: Prologue
source:
Rosebury Hangman: Prologue is a comedy-mystery visual novel about a detective who thought moving to a new city would fix his life. Spoiler: it didn’t.

Now jobless, broke, and spiraling into existential dread, Ryan Chase stumbles into a ridiculous case involving theft, suspiciously secretive girls, and a maybe-possibly-actual serial killer. What could possibly go wrong?

Features:
Renamable main character
Possible love interest
Detective notebook system
Loads of sarcasm
A rubber duck may or may not be involved

Grab your notebook, put aside your emotional trauma, and dive into the most absurd case of your (admittedly short) career.
translation:
《罗斯伯里刽子手：序言》是一部喜剧悬疑视觉小说，讲述了一名侦探认为搬到新城市可以改善自己的生活的故事。剧透：事实并非如此。

瑞恩·蔡斯 (Ryan Chase) 现在失业、身无分文，陷入了生存恐惧之中，他无意中卷入了一起荒唐的案件，涉及盗窃、可疑的秘密女孩和一个可能是真实的连环杀手。可能会出现什么问题？

特点：
可重命名主角
可能的爱情兴趣
侦探笔记本系统
大量的讽刺
橡皮鸭可能参与也可能不参与

拿起你的笔记本，抛开你的情感创伤，深入研究你（诚然短暂）职业生涯中最荒谬的案例。
